center.title: Settings
center.workspaceClosedHint: Select another workspace or return to work.

unsaved.title: Save your changes?
unsaved.description: Your workspace has unapplied changes. If saving fails, stay here to inspect the error and try again.

providers.label: Agents
providers.hint: Agent CLIs, custom agents and idle conversations

policy.label: Policy
policy.hint: What agents are blocked from using

general.title: General
general.description: Preferences that apply across every workspace.
general.cacheHint: Keep terminal views available when switching workspaces. Changes apply automatically.

seenSites.label: Sites you've opened
seenSites.hint: A link to a site you haven't opened from OXESpace before asks first. Clear the list to be asked again for every site.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Mode, interface scale, density, motion and language for the whole app.

dark.label: Dark
dark.hint: Dark surfaces with warm yellow accents

language.title: Language
language.hint: Applies to the whole interface. Agents answer in the language you write in.

scale.title: Interface scale
scale.hint: Makes text, controls and the terminal larger or smaller across the app. Currently {{scale}}.

density.title: Density
density.hint: How tightly controls and lists sit. Workspaces and the OxeChat list follow this unless you set their own.
density.useAppInWorkspaces: Use app density in all workspaces
density.threadOverride: The OxeChat list uses its own density: {{density}}.
density.useAppInThread: Use app density in the OxeChat list

system.label: System
system.hint: Follows your operating system’s reduced-motion setting.

reduce.label: Reduced
reduce.hint: Panels and lists change without animating; busy indicators turn slowly.

full.label: Full
full.hint: Short transitions on panels, lists and menus, even if the operating system asks for less.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Compact local diagnostics: up to 1.5 MiB for seven days. Export excludes prompts, terminal output and command arguments.
diagnostics.collected: Collected locally · exports redact paths and secrets

health.title: Health
health.measuring: Measured every few seconds, only while this page is open.
health.unavailable: Live measurements aren't available in this version of OXESpace.

normal.text: Average of the last measurements. Normal.

high.text: OXESpace has been busy: {{percent}}% CPU on average.
high.action: See which part is busy under Processes and agents, and stop terminals or agents you aren't using.

veryHigh.text: OXESpace is using {{percent}}% CPU on average; the computer may feel slow.
veryHigh.action: Stop terminals or agents you aren't using. If it stays this high, ask for analysis.

high.action: Close panes, conversations and OxeQuery tabs you aren't using.

veryHigh.text: OXESpace is using {{bytes}} of memory; the computer may start to slow down.
veryHigh.action: Close what you aren't using, or restart OXESpace. If it grows again, ask for analysis.

normal.text: Plenty of room for the database and logs.

low.text: Only {{bytes}} free on the disk that holds OXESpace's data.
low.action: Free some space soon: the database and logs need room to save your work.

almostFull.action: Free space now: empty the recycle bin or remove large files you don't need.

unknown.text: The free space couldn't be read.
unknown.action: Nothing to do here. If saving fails, check the disk in your system settings.

large.text: The local database has grown to {{bytes}}.
large.action: Archive or delete conversations you no longer need.

busy.text_one: The database was busy once in the last day.
busy.text_other: The database was busy {{count}} times in the last day.
busy.action: Close other OXESpace windows. If it keeps happening, ask for analysis.

processes.title: Processes and agents
processes.detail: Terminals: {{terminals}} · Agents: {{agents}} · MCP servers healthy: {{mcpHealthy}} of {{mcpTotal}}

mcpFailing.action: Open Tools › MCP servers to see the error and restart the server.

mcpQuarantined.text_one: {{count}} MCP server is quarantined after it changed.
mcpQuarantined.text_other: {{count}} MCP servers are quarantined after they changed.
mcpQuarantined.action: Review the change in Tools › MCP servers before trusting it again.

heavyProcess.action: Close panes and conversations you aren't using. If it keeps growing, restart OXESpace.

phone.phoneUnavailable: Phone access isn't part of this build.
phone.phoneNone: Phone access is on; no phone is paired.

offline.action: Agents, updates and the phone need the network. Check Wi-Fi or the cable; OXESpace reconnects by itself.

phoneAway.action: Open OXESpace on the phone, on the same network, or pair it again.

unknown.text: The connection hasn't been checked yet.
unknown.action: Nothing to do yet; the next measurement checks it.

journal.title: Problem journal
journal.description: Problems OXESpace noted on this computer in the last 30 days, grouped by kind. No content, prompts or paths.

actions.app: Nothing to do; the journal starts over by itself. If it happens again, ask for analysis.
actions.window: Restart OXESpace if the window misbehaves. If it happens again, ask for analysis.
actions.ipc: Try the action again. If it keeps failing, ask for analysis.
actions.agent: Check that the agent's CLI is installed and signed in, in Settings › Agents.
actions.mcp: Review the server's change in Tools › MCP servers before trusting it again.
actions.database: Close other OXESpace windows. If it keeps happening, ask for analysis.
actions.oxequery: Check the database connection and try a smaller query.
actions.updater: Check your connection and try again in Settings › Updates.
actions.interaction: If the app feels slow, close panes and conversations you aren't using.

journal.empty: No problems noted in the last 30 days.
journal.clearDescription: Every noted problem is removed from this computer. Problems are noted again from now on.

actions.label: Diagnostics actions
actions.askHint: Opens a new conversation with the diagnostics summary in its draft. Nothing is sent until you send it.

bundle.title: Export diagnostics bundle
bundle.description: What the .zip will contain, already redacted. Nothing is sent anywhere.
bundle.redactions_one: {{count}} value was redacted (paths, names and secrets).
bundle.redactions_other: {{count}} values were redacted (paths, names and secrets).

providers.title: Agents
providers.description: Manage your agents, CLI installations and custom profiles.
providers.healthCheckTitle: Detect which agent CLIs are installed

summary.runToDetect: Run Health check to detect installed CLIs
summary.installThenRun: Install a CLI, then run Health check

onboarding.title: Get an agent CLI on this machine
onboarding.body: OXESpace launches agents as local CLIs. Install one of the guides below, ensure the command is on PATH, then run Health check.

empty.title: No providers found
empty.hint: Run a health check to discover installed agent CLIs.

card.notOnPath: Not on PATH — install or Fix path

idle.title: Idle conversations
idle.hint: Each open OxeChat conversation keeps an agent process and its MCP servers running. Closing idle ones frees memory; your next message resumes the same session. A conversation with a running turn, a question, queued messages, a background task or a permission allowed for the session stays open.

semantic.title: Semantic index (beta)
semantic.switchLabel: Search by meaning with the semantic index

state.off: Off. Agents search with exact terms (FTS5) and code structure (CodeGraph).
state.notInstalled: On, but the model is not installed. Download it or import it from a folder.
state.ready: Ready. Agents also search by meaning; files are embedded in the background.

semantic.hint: The model ({{model}}) runs on this machine and is kept in the app's data folder, so updates do not download it again. To import, choose a folder with config.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and onnx/model_quantized.onnx.
semantic.usage: Agent searches so far: {{without}} without the index, {{with}} with it (counted on this machine only).
semantic.changeFailed: Could not change the semantic index.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Dictate with local transcription and your preferred shortcuts.
voice.captureHint: Press the shortcut, or Esc to cancel
voice.engineMissing: Voice input needs the whisper.cpp engine, which this version ships for Windows only. The model download starts once the engine is available on this system.
voice.callout: Local recognition (whisper.cpp), Brazilian Portuguese. Hold the shortcut to speak; tap the mic for hands-free.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: Set the default font, cursor and behavior for every workspace. Workspace overrides remain independent.
terminal.sizeHint: Ctrl + / Ctrl − / Ctrl 0 in a terminal
terminal.blinkHint: Animate the caret in focused terminals
terminal.resumeHint: After OXESpace restarts, Claude Code and Codex panes reopen the session they were in

hooks.title: Agent status hooks
hooks.callout: Let Claude Code and Codex report working / waiting / done themselves instead of guessing from terminal output. Writes to the agent's own config; your existing hooks are kept.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose when OXESpace gets your attention.
notifications.notify: Notify when an agent needs you
notifications.notifyHint: Desktop alerts when a background agent finishes, exits, or errors. Clicking focuses the terminal.
notifications.onlyUnwatched: Only for terminals you are not watching.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Keep OXESpace and its tools up to date.

status.availableManual: Update {{version}} available — install it from Releases
status.availableAuto: Update {{version}} available — downloading in the background

updates.checkTitle: Check GitHub Releases for a new version

hint.manual: Development and Linux package installs cannot update in place. Use the latest release or update your development checkout.
hint.ask: Downloaded updates install when you restart.
hint.auto: Downloads in the background. Restart to apply.

status.dev: Works in dev — check or install the sidecar anytime

rtk.hint: Sidecar binary. Updates independently of OXESpace.

preferences.label: How OXESpace updates
preferences.stayHint: Keep this version until you turn this off.
preferences.betaOn: You get each beta as it comes out. Turning this off keeps your version until a newer stable one is out.
preferences.betaOff: Try upcoming features early. Betas are tested, but can change before the stable release.

hint.pinned: Staying on v{{version}}: OXESpace does not check or download updates. Check for updates still tells you what is new.
hint.auto: Checks every few hours, downloads in the background and installs when you restart.
hint.notify: Checks every few hours and tells you when a version is out. Nothing downloads until you choose.
hint.off: Never checks on its own. Use Check for updates when you want to know.

policy.title: Policy
policy.intro: Rules that block what agents may use: providers, tools, MCP servers, skills, databases and shared memory. They only block; they never grant anything. To change a rule, edit the file. The last matching rule decides, so the managed file wins.

user.label: User
user.hint: Applies to you on this computer

managed.label: Managed
managed.hint: Installed by an administrator; has the final word

policy.fileError: This file has an error and is ignored.

activity.title: Agent activity
activity.hint: What agents changed through OXESpace (commits, pushes, pull requests, conversations, tasks, skills, automations) and what you decided. Database and container requests are listed in OxeQuery.

automations.title: Scheduled automations
automations.callout: Runs an agent with a prompt in a new worktree at the chosen time, with no terminal open. The app must be running; missed times are skipped, not run later.

form.name: Name
form.precheckHint: Command run at the repository root; the run only continues if it exits with code 0.
form.extraArgsHint: There is no interactive approval, so the agent only uses what these arguments allow.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.intro: Shortcuts work in the view named by each group. Press ? outside a text field to see the ones for the current screen. A focused terminal keeps every key except the command palette, Settings and the sidebar shortcuts.
keyboard.capturing: Press the new shortcut, or Esc to cancel

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: Use OXESpace from your Android phone on the same network: follow conversations, answer requests and watch terminals. The phone talks only to this computer, over your local network, never through the internet.
devices.loadFailed: Could not read the phone connection.
devices.unavailable: The phone connection is not available in this version.

gateway.title: Phone connection
gateway.label: Let phones on this network connect
gateway.hint: Off by default. When on, OXESpace listens only on private network addresses, over an encrypted connection that only paired phones can use.
gateway.failed: Could not change the phone connection: {{error}}

firewall.title: Before phones can connect
firewall.windowsAsk: Windows will ask whether OXESpace may accept connections. Allow it on private networks, such as your home or office Wi-Fi.
firewall.windowsPublic: Public networks can stay unchecked: the phone and this computer talk only over your local network.
firewall.otherAsk: Your system may ask whether OXESpace may accept incoming connections. Allow it so phones on your network can reach this computer.
firewall.internet: Nothing is exposed to the internet. OXESpace listens only on private network addresses, and only phones you pair here can use the connection.
firewall.later: If you refuse, phones cannot reach this computer. You can change the answer later in the firewall settings of your system.

name.title: Name of this computer
name.label: Name phones see
name.hint: Shown on the phone when it connects. The network name of your computer is never sent.
name.empty: Type a name, or use the default.

pairing.title: Pair a phone
pairing.hint: Open OXESpace on the phone and scan the code. Each code works once and lasts two minutes.
pairing.needsGateway: Turn on the phone connection first.
pairing.full: You have reached {{max}} phones. Remove one to pair another.
pairing.qrLabel: Pairing QR code. Point the phone's camera at the code.
pairing.fingerprintHint: The phone checks this before it trusts the connection.
pairing.failed: Could not show a pairing code: {{error}}
pairing.unreadable: The pairing code could not be read. Show a new code.

prompt.title: Pair {{device}}?
prompt.description: Pair only if the phone shows the same code.

list.title: Paired phones
list.emptyHint: Pair a phone above to see it here.
list.removeDescription: The phone is disconnected right away and can no longer connect. To use it again, pair it again.

typing.title: Typing in terminals
typing.none: Phones cannot type in any terminal. To allow it in one terminal, open its ⋯ menu and choose "Allow typing from the phone". It turns off again when OXESpace restarts.
typing.some: Terminals a phone can type in: {{count}}. It turns off again when OXESpace restarts.
typing.stopAll: Stop typing from the phone everywhere
typing.failed: Could not stop typing from the phone: {{error}}

scope.title: What a phone can do
scope.deskOnly: Requests that only this computer can answer (guarded actions, permissions and secret questions) stay here.

subscriptions.thread: Follow a conversation as it happens

commands.threadSend: Send a message to a conversation
commands.threadSteer: Steer a turn while it runs
commands.threadRespondRequest: Accept or decline a conversation request, after confirming on the phone with fingerprint or face
commands.terminalWrite: Type in a terminal you allowed here

forbidden.mcpConfirm: Confirm MCP tool calls that ask for it
forbidden.threadAccess: Change what a conversation may access
